item.title: Laravel Notes
item.description: Laravel Notes Add a new column to existing table in a migration Suppose I want to add user_id column into existing table called timelog. php artisan make:migration add_user_id –table="timelog” Then add new column in new migration file $table->integer(‘user_id’)->unsigned()->index(); php artisan migrate To undo the last migration php artisan migrate:rollback
